details: LTX is a family of generative artificial intelligence video models, developed by Lightricks.

explainer.lead: LTX is a family of generative AI video models developed by Lightricks. It matters as the model side of a broader video-generation ecosystem.

tiers.eli5: It's a set of engines that generate video, made by the same company behind a video-making product.
tiers.practitioner: Used for generative video work, including an open-source model (LTX-2) and commercial API access within the LTX ecosystem.
tiers.paperLevel: Described as a family of generative video models; specific architectures and evaluation limits are not given.

explainer.example: A developer calls LTX through its commercial API to generate video from a prompt.
